channel.title: RestockRally
channel.description: Fast sneaker release dates, restocks and raffles

item.title: How to read a Nike box label, and what it can tell you
item.description: Nike's size charts explain that the CM figure on a box or label is not your foot length. Here is how to compare a box label with the official product page, and what a label cannot prove on its own.

item.title: How to look up a Nike style code or SKU
item.description: Nike lists a style or SKU on its product and SNKRS launch pages. Here is how to use that code to find the matching official listing, and how we write codes on this site.

item.title: How sneaker restocks work at Nike, Foot Locker and Finish Line
item.description: Restocks are not one shared inventory pool. Here is what Nike, Foot Locker and Finish Line actually publish about notifications, launch entries, store stock and STATUS Exclusive Access.

item.title: What SNKRS Exclusive Access is, and how Exclusive Draw differs
item.description: Nike describes Exclusive Access as an invitation to buy selected products outside regular SNKRS launches. Here is what Nike says about invitations, timing, Exclusive Draw, and why access is never guaranteed.

item.title: Nike sizing by model: charts, conversions and how to measure
item.description: Nike publishes one men's and one women's footwear size chart, not a separate chart for every model. Here is how to measure, convert men's and women's sizes, and read the CM figure on a box.

item.title: Nike lists the Kobe 8 Protro Shanghai Fireworks on SNKRS at $200
item.description: Nike's SNKRS launch page for the Laser Orange and Safety Orange Kobe 8 Protro, SKU IO6259-800, shows a $200 price and a U.S. commerce start of 11 November 2026 at 10:23 a.m. ET.

item.title: Nike SB Dunk Low “Ducks of a Feather” dates: The Zoo in November, Shout! in December
item.description: Sneaker News reported on 9 November that Division Street's Ducks of a Feather collection will release The Zoo at Flight Club and on the GOAT app in late November, with Shout! following in December.

item.title: Vinícius Júnior's Laser Orange Mercurial Vapor 17 is set for 12 November at $270
item.description: House of Heat said Nike has unveiled a Laser Orange and Fuchsia Flash Mercurial Vapor 17 player edition inspired by Brazilian funk, releasing on 12 November for $270 in the Elite FG version.

item.title: SNKRS vs Retail Partners: How to Choose Where to Enter a Sneaker Drop
item.description: Compare Nike SNKRS launches with retail-partner drops, including entry methods, Exclusive Access, shipping, returns and the seller responsible for your order.

item.title: Sneaker Shipping Delays: What the FTC Mail Order Rule Requires
item.description: Understand shipping promises, delay notices, cancellation rights and refunds under the FTC Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule for online sneaker orders.

item.title: NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer drops today in three women's colorways at $130

item.title: Kith x New Balance 2011 "Monuments" collection releases November 9

item.title: Nike Air Force 1 Mid "Baroque Brown" preview: IQ0189-200, $125

item.title: Air Max 90 Triple Black already listed below $165 retail ahead of November 13 release

item.title: What is a sneaker restock, and how do you catch one?
item.description: A restock is a pair coming back after it sold out. Here is where restocks come from, why they rarely get an announcement, and practical ways to catch one.

item.title: Nike kids' shoe sizes explained: what C and Y mean on release day
item.description: Nike splits kids' shoes into baby and toddler (1C to 10C), little kids (10.5C to 3Y) and big kids (3.5Y to 7Y). Here is how that maps to adult sizes.

item.title: How to spot a fake sneaker release ad or raffle
item.description: FTC advice applied to sneaker drops: go to the retailer's own site, distrust deep discounts, pay by credit card and never pay to enter a raffle.
